short_description: TNG DOLORES (LRS) low-resolution spectrograph and camera filters

licence.scope: No owner statement found. Checked the TNG filters page (http://www.tng.iac.es/instruments/filters/), the TNG home page, the acknowledgement page (credit line only), the transparency page and the privacy notice (https://www.tng.iac.es/lopd/gdpr-web-privacy.html): none states copyright or reuse terms for the filter data, and www.inaf.it did not answer curl. Page SVO cites: http://www.tng.iac.es/instruments/filters/. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
